# Icon Library — Review-Refine Pass 1 notes

> **Stage 3 of 5** (requirements → iteration 1 → **REFINE ×3**). Built with `strok`.
> Date: 2026-06-20. Pass 1 focus per brief: **correctness, the flagged weak icons, grid/alignment,
> confusable pairs, and currentColor integrity.** Whole-set optical-weight balancing is mostly pass 2.

## What I changed (per icon — edited `.strok` sources only; SVGs regenerated by `build.sh`)

### Flagged weak icons (the three the builder called out)
- **`cycle`** — Redrawn. Was an open ⌀16 ring with a 3-point stub at the top-right that read as a small
  flag/hook. Now a near-full circular loop (9-point catmull ring centered ~12,12) with a proper chevron
  **arrowhead** at the top terminal. Reads unambiguously as "cycle / recurring." Sweeps opposite to
  `rerun` so the two circular-arrow glyphs stay distinct.
- **`link`** — Redrawn. Was two overlapping C-rings + a diagonal bar that fused into a single blob at
  16px. Now the canonical **chain-link**: a central horizontal connector bar (9,12→15,12) plus a left
  open hook and a right open hook (each a 5-point catmull C opening inward). The two interlocking rings +
  bar read as a chain at 16px. Stays distinct from `external-link` (navigate-away arrow).
- **`pull-request`** — Redrawn (was the densest glyph: left rail + converging arc + arrowhead + 3 nodes).
  Now the canonical git-pull-request silhouette: a left **source branch** (top node + bottom node + rail)
  and a right **target** (bottom node + rail) with an up-pointing chevron **arrowhead** at the top of the
  right rail. Removed the heavy converging arc entirely — far lighter optical weight, still reads as "PR."

### Confusable pair: branch vs merge (the named glyphs)
- **`branch`** and **`merge`** were nearly indistinguishable — both were "two top nodes + one bottom node
  joined by a near-identical S-curve." Redrew both to the canonical, genuinely-distinct Lucide forms,
  sharing the same node vocabulary (three ⌀6 nodes + a vertical rail):
  - **`branch`** — straight rail (top↔bottom-left nodes); a branch line **diverges** from mid-rail up and
    out to the top-right node (near-horizontal split high on the glyph).
  - **`merge`** — straight rail (top↔bottom-left nodes); a line **converges** from the top-right node and
    sweeps all the way **down into the bottom-left node**. The deep downward convergence is the
    distinguishing read (vs branch's high horizontal split). Verified distinct at 16px.

## What I checked and deliberately LEFT for pass 2 (or left as-is by design)
- **Whole-set optical-weight balancing (pass 2's job).** Specifics to tune:
  - Filled dots (`agent`, `nav-issues`) vs all-outline glyphs — confirm none reads heavier at 16px.
  - Lightest glyphs: `channel` (`#`, 4 strokes), `priority` (3 bars). Heaviest/most-enclosed: `run`
    (rounded-square + play), `nav-ci` (circle + play), `agent` (rounded-square + dot), `database`
    (cylinder). Consider nudging stroke-coverage so the enclosed glyphs don't dominate a CI row.
  - `cycle` arrowhead is slightly large relative to the loop — fine at 16px, but a candidate to shrink
    for weight parity in pass 2.
- **`close` (×) vs `check-fail` (✗)** are currently byte-identical bare X glyphs. **Left intentionally:**
  this matches the universal convention (GitHub/Lucide use the same mark for dismiss and check-failed) and
  the two never co-occur in the same context (chip corner / dialog vs CI status row). Flagging for a
  pass-2 decision only if the team wants a hard one-glyph-per-meaning split (e.g. enclose the check family).
- **`nav-chat` vs `message`** are both speech bubbles, differentiated only by internal text-lines in
  `nav-chat`. Subtle at 16px but they are a subsystem-rail glyph vs an inline object glyph (context
  disambiguates), and redrawing risks the name→meaning contract. Left for pass 2 to judge whether
  `nav-chat` needs a more distinct chat-subsystem treatment.
- **`run` vs `nav-ci`** — checked: `run` is a rounded-**square** + play, `nav-ci` is a **circle** + play.
  The square/circle distinction is deliberate and reads fine; **no change.**
- **`cycle` vs `rerun`** — both circular arrows but sweep in opposite directions with arrowheads at
  different terminals; distinct at 16px. **No change.**
- **`check-pending`** is a clock (in-progress) rather than the spec's ◐ suggestion — clearer; kept.
- **`linecap`/`linejoin round` vs `butt`** (the §6 HOUSE-STYLE taste call) — left at `round` throughout;
  reads calm and consistent beside the near-zero-radius UI. Defer the final round-vs-butt call.

## currentColor re-verification (after rebuild) — **PASS**
Ran `bash build.sh` (rebuilt all 42), then:
- `grep -L 'currentColor' svg/*.svg` → **empty** (every shipped SVG has `currentColor`).
- `grep -l '#ff00ff' svg/*.svg` → **empty** (no leftover sentinel hex).
- `grep -l '#' svg/*.svg` → **empty** (no hardcoded hex of any kind in `svg/`).
`fill="none"` preserved; the only intentional fills remain the centered status/identity dots
(`agent`, `nav-issues`, etc.). build.sh re-run is a no-op diff.
